integrity: The proof establishes every infinite statement without relying on finite enumeration. The included checker supplies only bounded arithmetic consistency checks; an equivalent unindexed result remains a literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to contiguous Abelian squares of the classical binary Thue–Morse word, and to natural density of indexed starting positions. No claims on higher Abelian powers, distinct factor counts, or exact finite-prefix counts.
title: Exact Abelian-square occurrence densities for every Thue–Morse block length
